name: 48507 · Flint, MI
findings: ZIP 48507 (Flint) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 53 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48507 (Flint) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48507 (Flint) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
